mechanism_narrative: A quarterly GDP growth rate exceeding 0.5% in GDPC1 signals robust economic expansion, reducing equity risk premiums and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as investors allocate capital to cyclical equities.
failure_condition: GDPC1 quarterly growth > 0.5% but 20-day forward returns negative in >60% of cases over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in FEDFUNDS below 0.1% per annum triggers a monetary easing cycle that lowers discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS < 0.1% but 20-day forward returns negative in >50% of instances over 2-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous payroll growth in PAYEMS exceeding 0.3% monthly and unemployment rate decline below 8.5% in UNRATE signal tightening labor markets, accelerating consumer spending and generating positive S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Both conditions met but 5-day forward returns negative in >40% of cases over 1-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production growth above 95 index in INDPRO during high-output regimes indicates manufacturing strength, reducing equity volatility and generating positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO > 95 index but 20-day forward returns negative in >55% of cases during high-output regimes.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts exceeding 650,000 units in HOUST signal sustained consumer confidence and construction activity, driving equity demand and generating positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST > 650k but 60-day forward returns negative in >60% of cases over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: CPIAUCSL inflation exceeding 227.0 index (YoY > 2.5%) triggers Fed policy tightening, increasing equity discount rates and generating negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL > 227.0 but 20-day forward returns positive in >50% of cases over 2-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous housing starts above 620,000 units in HOUST and retail sales growth exceeding $380 billion in RSAFS signal strong consumer spending, generating positive S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Both conditions met but 5-day forward returns negative in >45% of cases over 1-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 8.5% in UNRATE during high-unemployment regimes signals labor market weakness, reducing consumer spending and generating negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE > 8.5% but 20-day forward returns positive in >55% of cases during high-unemployment regimes.
